# `kernel/protocol/CapabilityNegotiator.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/protocol/CapabilityNegotiator.js`

CapabilityNegotiator.js — Particle Realms Protocol capability minting. Thin wrapper over engine/state's CapabilityRegistry + Capability.js (makeCapability/attenuate/authorizes) — no parallel capability logic. Used by the AI Hub's two-pass execution loop (Phase 9) to mint short-lived, narrowly-scoped capabilities for a single OS.ai() request's tool/resource access, on top of (not instead of) the RuleGraph/Permissions manifest gate.

## Classes

### `class CapabilityNegotiator`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(kernel)` |  |
| `negotiate` | `negotiate({ appId, object, action, constraints = {}, expiryEpoch = null, singleUse = false, delegable = true })` | Mint and register a capability for `appId` to perform `action` on `object` (a tool name, resource URI, or prompt name). |
| `check` | `check(capId, request)` |  |
| `revoke` | `revoke(capId)` |  |
| `consume` | `consume(capId)` |  |
| `narrow` | `narrow(cap, caveat)` | Narrow a capability with an additional caveat — never widens (Capability.attenuate enforces this). |
| `authorizes` | `authorizes(cap, request)` | Direct authorization check without touching the registry (e.g. for a capability minted elsewhere). |

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```
